input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and constitutes walk-away territory (foreign law with exclusive foreign venue). It also directly conflicts with Section 28.2, which grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. The redline changes only the jurisdiction and forum words in 28.1 to New York law and New York County courts, reaching the preferred position and harmonising the section; 28.3's pre-suit escalation preserves urgent relief and is unaffected.

proposal.summary: Replace Singapore governing law/venue in 28.1 with New York law and New York County courts, consistent with 28.2.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law and forum in 28.1 from Singapore to New York law and the state and federal courts in New York County, which is our standard position and removes the direct conflict with the exclusive New York venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales with the London courts would also work for us.

ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: the law of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction
